basis: Known positive at this SHA: GHSA-735f-pc8j-v9w8 lists protobuf-java/javalite 4.28.0-RC1..4.28.2 as affected (also 4.0.0-RC1..4.27.5 and <3.25.5); v28.1 is Maven 4.28.1 and commit 10ef3f77. Root cause: UnknownFieldSchema.mergeOneFieldFrom WIRETYPE_START_GROUP calls mergeFrom without any depth accounting (java/core/.../UnknownFieldSchema.java:75-78), and the DiscardUnknownFields path recurses through CodedInputStream.skipMessage, so nested SGROUP tags overflow the JVM stack (StackOverflowError). v28.2 adds DEFAULT_RECURSION_LIMIT=100 and depth checks (ac9fb5b4).
notes: Known positive for this SHA; vulnerability_id links to the selected-snapshot oracle row.
